item.overgearedmod.fracaso_blueprint.des: Only the Legendary Smith Successor can use it: at the anvil, with 15 blue orichalcum ingots. Used up by the forge.
stat.overgearedmod.strength.desc: Per point: +%s attack damage. Boosts area skill damage.
stat.overgearedmod.intelligence.desc: Per point: +%s max mana and +%s mana per second.
stat.overgearedmod.dexterity.desc: Per point: +%s%% attack speed. Improves forging ratings and enhancement odds.
screen.overgearedmod.npc_no_quests: I have nothing for you right now.
screen.overgearedmod.no_quests_story: No quests to do right now.
screen.overgearedmod.quest_track_tooltip: Show this quest on the HUD panel (up to %s).
screen.overgearedmod.confirm_class_chang: Claiming this quest will change your class from %s to %s. This can't be undone. Continue?
screen.overgearedmod.confirm_class_first: Claiming this quest will give you the class %s. This can't be undone. Continue?
screen.overgearedmod.no_skills: You don't know any skill yet. Read a skill book.
screen.overgearedmod.forge_auto.tooltip: Automatic forging: takes a few seconds depending on your smithing and DEX. Normal odds.
screen.overgearedmod.forge_manual.toolti: Manual forging: heat the metal and hammer it. Done well, a better rating and maybe an extra option; done badly, worse than automatic. Double smithing XP.
screen.overgearedmod.smelter_auto.toolti: Lights the fire and melts one piece after another once it is hot enough. May give an extra ingot by your smithing level. Heating up from cold burns fuel twice as fast.
screen.overgearedmod.smelter_fire.toolti: Douses the fire at once: the burning piece of fuel is lost and the smelter starts to cool.
screen.overgearedmod.smelter_bellows.too: Melts one piece by hand with the bellows. If it is cold, it lights the fire first and tells you when it is ready. Done well: faster, maybe an extra ingot and double smithing XP; overheat it or let it cool and some metal ends up as slag.
minigame.overgearedmod.title: Manual forging
minigame.overgearedmod.heat: Hold (click or space) to heat and release when the temperature is in the golden band
minigame.overgearedmod.hammer: Strike (click or space) when the marker crosses the middle · %s/%s
minigame.overgearedmod.smelt_pump: Click or press space to pump the bellows and keep the metal in the golden zone.
class.overgearedmod.warrior.desc: Melee fighter. Starts with Pagma's Swordsmanship: Link.
class.overgearedmod.blacksmith.desc: Forges better gear and takes hits. Starts with Iron Guard.
class.overgearedmod.mage.desc: More mana and ranged spells. Starts with Flame Bolt.
class.overgearedmod.legendary_smith_succ: Advanced class. Great dexterity and far better smithing. Obtained through the quest Pagma's Legacy.
class.overgearedmod.night_hunter.desc: Hidden class. Agile and deadly against what lurks in the dark. Starts with Rending Slash.
title.overgearedmod.apprentice_smith.des: You have forged 5 items at the anvil.
title.overgearedmod.epic_forger.desc: You have forged an item of Epic rating or better.
quest.overgearedmod.zombie_plague.desc: Zombies prowl around the village. Repeatable.
quest.overgearedmod.first_commission.des: Smith trusts you with your first real commission: forge any item at the anvil.
quest.overgearedmod.quality_test.desc: Smith wants to see whether your first commission was luck. Forge two Rare or better items, automatically or by hand: both count.
quest.overgearedmod.call_of_the_night.de: So many broken bones have not gone unnoticed. Something in the dark is watching you: hunt 15 more skeletons and answer its call. Replaces your current class.
quest.overgearedmod.night_watch.desc: You held the zombies back. Now the chief asks you to deal with the skeletons that prowl the village at night.
quest.overgearedmod.path_of_the_adventur: Prove your progress and receive a skill book.
quest.overgearedmod.smith_firewood.desc: Smith doesn't teach the trade to just anyone. Prove you can work: bring him 64 logs for the forge.
quest.overgearedmod.smith_iron.desc: The forge is lit, but there is no metal. Dig in the mountain mine and bring Smith 32 raw iron (or the ores).
quest.overgearedmod.smith_jaffa_ingots.d: Smith teaches you to smelt jaffa. Mine jaffa ore, smelt it and hand him 8 ingots.
quest.overgearedmod.smith_jaffa_sword.de: Time to forge: with two jaffa ingots and a stick, forge a Jaffa sword at the anvil.
quest.overgearedmod.pagma_legacy.desc: Blacksmiths only. Forge a Unique or better item to inherit the legendary blacksmith's craft.
goal.overgearedmod.forge_rating: Forge %s items of %s rating or better
skill.overgearedmod.pagma_link.desc: Fan-shaped slash in front of you. Scales with STR and DEX. Needs a sword.
skill.overgearedmod.bisection.desc: A long, straight cut that splits whatever is in front of you. Scales with STR. Only with a Legendary Failure in hand, on the weapon skill key.
skill.overgearedmod.iron_guard.desc: Resistance II and absorption for a few seconds.
skill.overgearedmod.flame_bolt.desc: Throws three small fireballs where you look.
skill.overgearedmod.rending_slash.desc: A short slash that makes enemies bleed (Bleeding II). Requires a sword.
notification.overgearedmod.title: You have earned a title
notification.overgearedmod.quest_discove: You have discovered a hidden quest

message.overgearedmod.smelter_no_fuel: There is no fuel to light the fire

message.overgearedmod.smelter_ready: The smelter is ready for the bellows
message.overgearedmod.smelter_extra: A pure melt! An extra ingot
message.overgearedmod.requirements_unmet: You don't meet this item's requirements
message.overgearedmod.death_xp_lost: You died and lost %s XP from your current level
message.overgearedmod.quest_tracking_ful: You already follow %s quests on the HUD
message.overgearedmod.respec_done: Points refunded: you have %s to spend
message.overgearedmod.respec_nothing: You have no allocated points to refund
message.overgearedmod.simulate_not_a_mob: That entity is not a mob
